en: The postcard features a collage of colorful images: a panoramic cityscape with a historic building and a tower, a busy beach with people sunbathing, a popular public fountain scene, crowded cafes with people enjoying themselves, and a view overlooking the seaside and port. The center of the postcard has the name Варна (Varna) prominently displayed in Cyrillic script against a yellow background.
